stateOwnerDisposition: Owns native shell/window/session state, a bounded durable operation journal, and opaque keyring references; backend domain facts, authority and signing private keys remain with their owners.
terminalObserverDisposition: The authenticated backend, local platform adapter, and separately verified updater supply observations; uncertain OS effects remain indeterminate when no trustworthy terminal query exists, and the shell cannot self-issue success.

operations.sourceSemantics: Verifies the signed/authenticated backend connection, creates a new session incarnation, fences cached receipts, restores durable pending operations and reconciles before reuse.

Fetches the authenticated backend runtime status, binds its body digest and snapshot generation to the active session incarnation, and rejects mixed or regressed presentation state; arbitrary callers cannot inject a product view.

Binds subject, session incarnation, operation ID, displayed revision, action/resource payload, final payload digest, exact FinalUseBinding and signed grant identity into the durable operation record; claims kernel FinalUseAuthority, fsyncs Invoking before effect entry, revalidates current authority immediately before the local platform adapter, and reconciles uncertainty without replay.

Re-verifies the signed stable-channel manifest, staged package and installed predecessor digests in a separate updater process, then atomically activates or restores the predecessor and waits for new-binary confirmation.

repositoryControlledGaps: Commit a reproducible native Cargo.lock and observe current exact-head plus Windows/macOS/Linux merge-candidate execution receipts for the final claim-bearing candidate.

Run the packaged fault/restart qualification against the final candidate, including updater-process death and cross-generation effect reconciliation; repository tests must not convert unavailable OS terminal observation into success.
externalEvidenceGates: production Authenticode, Apple Developer ID/notarization and Linux distribution signing/repository ownership
installed Windows AppUserModelID notification identity plus real target-host OS permission/revocation evidence where applicable
independent screen-reader/accessibility acceptance, operator acceptance, promotion and release
